notes: A scored rugby match between teams on a marked pitch is Sports, and the space is the field itself — space-bounded, with touchlines as the perimeter, in-goal areas and posts as the scoring planes, kickoff and conversion spots as restart positions, and the halfway and 22-metre lines as markings. Full Stadium is the preset because the answers ask for a full floodlit professional ground, so tiered seating, the stadium wall and team benches come with it; the bleachers are what make this P0 + tiered. Almost everything in the brief is systems rather than space — controls, coins, XP, ranks, the Studio hierarchy — and the shop and scoreboard are explicitly StarterGui, so I did not site an upgrades storefront in the world the way a physical shop would need. Decided without a user: one pitch tightened for 7v7 with 15v15 played on the same surface, and quick match, ranked, practice and tournament treated as matchmaking over that single field rather than separate maps, which keeps the build off P4; floodlight masts match no option and belong in the image stream as free text.
